b1.descriptionHtml:
Same trusted Signicade hardware with an easy-change coroplast insert, so you can swap graphics without replacing the whole sign.

24in x 36in, delivered anywhere in 5 business days from proof approval.

b2.descriptionHtml:
A heavier-duty retractable base with a premium finish, available single or double sided so your message reads from both directions in a walkway or aisle.

33in x 81in, dye-sublimated print, delivered anywhere in 5 business days from proof approval.

b3.descriptionHtml:
The classic roll-up banner stand — pull the graphic up, lock the pole, done. Single-sided full-color print on a lightweight retractable base that fits in its own carry bag.

Dye-sublimated print, delivered anywhere in 5 business days from proof approval.

b4.descriptionHtml:
Custom printed half wall for 10ft event tents — delivered in 5 business days from proof approval.

Dye-sublimated print on weatherproof tent fabric. Attaches to your event tent frame with a top pole pocket for a clean, professional look. Available in single-sided or double-sided print.

Perfect for adding branded visibility to the lower half of your booth while keeping the upper area open for interaction.

Every order proofed before production. 4.8★ rated. Printed in LA.

b5.descriptionHtml:
Custom printed podium that doubles as a hard case for your trade show displays — delivered in 5 business days from proof approval.

Full-color dye-sublimated fabric wrap on a sturdy podium frame. When not in use as a podium, the outer shell converts into a protective hard case for transporting your popup display hardware.

Two products in one — a branded presentation podium at the show, a protective shipping case on the road. Perfect for trade show teams who need professional setups without the bulk.

Every order proofed before production. 4.8★ rated. Printed in LA.

b6.descriptionHtml:
The budget-smart way to brand a table — a custom-printed runner laid over a solid blank table throw. You get the branded front-facing panel where it counts, without paying to print fabric nobody sees. Built to order, delivered in 5 business days from proof approval.

The runner is full-color dye-sublimated on durable polyester; the throw underneath comes in black or white to match your setup. A clean, professional look for a fraction of a fully-printed throw.

The details that matter

  • Custom dye-sub printed 6ft runner
  • Solid blank table throw included (black or white)
  • Fits standard 6ft tables
  • Every order is proofed before production
  • Printed to order in Los Angeles

Common questions

Why a runner instead of a full printed throw? You brand the panel people actually look at and save on the rest — a smart entry point for new vendors or anyone outfitting multiple tables.

How fast can I get one? Five business days from approved proof to shipped.

Custom table runner + throw combos, printed in LA and shipped 5 business days after proof approval. Call (844) 883-3308.

b7.descriptionHtml:
Custom printed tent banners — attach to any event tent for added branding. Delivered in 5 business days from proof approval.

Full-color dye-sublimated print on durable banner fabric. Available in sizes from 4ft x 1ft to 10ft x 3ft. Easily attaches to tent frame with hook-and-loop strips.

Add your logo, tagline, or promotional message to the valance of any standard event tent. Perfect for farmers markets, outdoor events, and trade shows.

Every order proofed before production. 4.8★ rated. Printed in LA.

b8.descriptionHtml:
The 10x20 is the double-booth play — 20 feet of branded frontage and an interior you can actually work in. Same build as our 10x10, scaled up: custom-printed end to end, built to order, and delivered in 5 business days from proof approval. Shipped nationwide.

The canopy is dye-sublimated in full color on weatherproof tent fabric — the ink bonds into the material, so it won't crack, peel, or wash out like surface vinyl. Heavy-duty powder-coated aluminum frame, pop-up, no tools, packs into a wheeled bag.

What you can build

  • Tent Only — custom canopy + frame
  • Half Wall — canopy + half back wall
  • Full Wall — canopy + full back wall for a 20-ft branded backdrop
  • Complete Set — canopy, full wall, and side rails: the whole double booth in one box

The details that matter

  • Full-color dye-sublimation print, edge to edge
  • Heavy-duty powder-coated aluminum frame
  • Pop-up setup, no tools
  • Wheeled carry bag included
  • Free digital proof before we print
  • Printed to order in Los Angeles, 20+ years of dye-sub production

Common questions

How fast can I get a custom 10x20 tent? Five business days from approved proof to shipped.

Is a 10x20 worth it over two 10x10s? For a double-booth space, yes — one continuous 20-ft canopy reads as a single brand moment instead of two tents pushed together.

Do I see a proof first? Always. Nothing prints until you approve the digital proof.

Custom 10x20 event tents, printed in LA and shipped 5 business days after proof approval. Questions on sizing or artwork? Call (844) 883-3308.

b9.descriptionHtml:
The 10x15 is the in-between footprint — more frontage and storage than a 10x10, without committing to a full double booth. Custom-printed end to end, built to order, delivered in 5 business days from proof approval. Shipped nationwide.

Full-color dye-sublimation on weatherproof tent fabric — ink bonded into the material, not sitting on top, so it holds up outdoors. Heavy-duty powder-coated aluminum frame, pop-up, no tools, wheeled carry bag included.

What you can build

  • Tent Only — custom canopy + frame
  • Half Wall — canopy + half back wall
  • Full Wall — canopy + full 15-ft back wall
  • Complete Set — canopy, full wall, and rails in one box

The details that matter

  • Full-color dye-sublimation print, edge to edge
  • Heavy-duty powder-coated aluminum frame
  • Pop-up setup, no tools
  • Wheeled carry bag included
  • Free digital proof before we print
  • Printed to order in Los Angeles

Common questions

How fast can I get a custom 10x15 tent? Five business days from approved proof to shipped.

When does a 10x15 make sense? When you've outgrown a 10x10 but the venue won't give you a full 10x20 — it buys you frontage and back-of-booth storage.

Do I see a proof first? Yes — free digital proof, no production without your sign-off.

Custom 10x15 event tents, printed in LA and shipped 5 business days after proof approval. Call (844) 883-3308 with questions.

b10.descriptionHtml:
Custom printed vinyl backdrop wraps — delivered in 5 business days from proof approval.

High-quality 3M vinyl print, available in 4ft x 7ft. Perfect for transforming walls, A-frames, and flat surfaces into branded backdrops for events, retail spaces, and activations.

Durable, easy to install, and removable without damaging surfaces. Full-color print on premium vinyl with a professional matte or gloss finish.

Every order proofed before production. 4.8★ rated. Printed in LA.

b11.descriptionHtml:
A 10-foot SEG backwall with edge LEDs behind the fabric — the graphic lights up from within and pulls eyes from across the hall. Silicone Edge Graphic finish for a seamless, frameless face; built to order, delivered in 5 business days from proof approval.

Full-color dye-sublimation on light-diffusing tension fabric, so the illumination reads even instead of hot-spotted. Tool-free aluminum frame with integrated LED housing, packs into a roller case.

Single vs. double sided

  • Single Side Print — illuminated front face
  • Double Sided Print — both faces lit, for freestanding placement

The details that matter

  • Edge-lit LED housing — even, diffused glow
  • Seamless silicone-edge fabric, no visible frame
  • Tool-free aluminum frame
  • Roller case included
  • Free digital proof before we print
  • Printed to order in Los Angeles

Common questions

Why backlit over standard? A lit backwall draws attention from across a crowded floor and makes color pop — worth it for high-traffic shows and dim venues.

How fast can I get one? Five business days from approved proof to shipped.

10ft illuminated SEG backwalls, printed in LA and shipped 5 business days after proof approval. Call (844) 883-3308.

b12.descriptionHtml:
The compact SEG — a 3-foot seamless fabric panel for tabletops, counters, and tight in-line spaces. Same Silicone Edge Graphic build as our larger displays: the print finishes in a silicone strip that push-fits into an aluminum channel for a frameless, drum-tight look. Built to order, delivered in 5 business days from proof approval.

Full-color dye-sublimation on wrinkle-resistant fabric. Tool-free setup, packs flat.

Single vs. double sided

  • Single Side Print — front-facing
  • Double Sided Print — both faces visible

The details that matter

  • Seamless silicone-edge fabric — no visible frame
  • Tool-free aluminum frame
  • Wrinkle-resistant dye-sub print
  • Carry bag included
  • Free digital proof before we print
  • Printed to order in Los Angeles

Common questions

Where does a 3ft SEG work best? Tabletops, reception counters, and narrow in-line booths where a full backwall won't fit.

How fast can I get one? Five business days from approved proof to shipped.

Compact 3ft SEG displays, printed in LA and shipped 5 business days after proof approval. Call (844) 883-3308.

b13.descriptionHtml:
A 10-foot seamless fabric backdrop with no visible frame — the standard SEG backwall for in-line booths and step-and-repeat. SEG (Silicone Edge Graphic) means the print finishes in a thin silicone strip that push-fits into an aluminum channel, pulling the graphic drum-tight. Built to order, delivered in 5 business days from proof approval.

Full-color dye-sublimation on wrinkle-resistant tension fabric. Tool-free assembly, packs into an included roller case.

Single vs. double sided

  • Single Side Print — front-facing backwall
  • Double Sided Print — both faces, for freestanding or divider use

The details that matter

  • Seamless silicone-edge fabric — no visible frame
  • Tool-free push-fit aluminum frame
  • Wrinkle-resistant dye-sub print
  • Roller case included
  • Free digital proof before we print
  • Printed to order in Los Angeles

Common questions

What is an SEG display? A Silicone Edge Graphic — fabric finished with a silicone strip that snaps into a frame channel for a seamless, frameless look.

How fast can I get one? Five business days from approved proof to shipped.

Do I see a proof first? Yes — nothing prints without your sign-off.

10ft SEG fabric backdrops, printed in LA and shipped 5 business days after proof approval. Call (844) 883-3308.

b14.descriptionHtml:
Custom-printed acrylic that floats off the wall on brushed-metal standoffs — the look you see in agency lobbies and flagship retail, made to your artwork. Printed in HD on crystal-clear acrylic, built to order, delivered in 5 business days from proof approval.

The standoff mounts hold the panel about an inch off the wall, so it casts a clean shadow line and reads as a dimensional object instead of a flat print. Good for office walls, lobbies, conference rooms, retail, and any branded interior that needs to look finished.

Sizes

  • 16" × 24"
  • 20" × 30"
  • 24" × 36"

The details that matter

  • HD direct print on clear acrylic
  • Brushed-metal standoff hardware included — floats ~1" off the wall
  • Ready to hang, mounting kit included
  • Every order is proofed before production
  • Printed to order in Los Angeles

Common questions

What are standoffs? Brushed-metal mounts that hold the acrylic panel slightly off the wall, creating depth and a clean floating shadow line.

Does it come ready to hang? Yes — hardware and a mounting template are included.

Can I print my logo or brand artwork? Yes. Send your file; we proof every order and match your colors before printing.

Custom standoff acrylic wall art, printed in LA, shipped 5 business days after proof approval. Call (844) 883-3308.

b15.descriptionHtml:
A 20-foot seamless backwall with no visible frame — just edge-to-edge graphic. SEG stands for Silicone Edge Graphic: the print is sewn with a thin silicone strip that push-fits into an aluminum channel, so the fabric pulls drum-tight and the frame disappears behind it. Built to order, delivered in 5 business days from proof approval.

This is the backwall that makes a 10x20 or in-line booth look like a brand built it, not a print shop. Dye-sublimated in full color on tension fabric — wrinkle-resistant and packs down into a roller case.

Single vs. double sided

  • Single Side Print — graphic on the front face, for backwall use against a wall or curtain
  • Double Sided Print — graphic on both faces, for room dividers or freestanding placement where both sides show

The details that matter

  • Seamless SEG silicone-edge fabric — no visible frame
  • Tool-free push-fit assembly into aluminum extrusion
  • Full-color dye-sublimation, wrinkle-resistant fabric
  • Roller case included
  • Free digital proof before we print
  • Printed to order in Los Angeles

Common questions

What is an SEG display? A Silicone Edge Graphic — a fabric print finished with a silicone strip that snaps into a frame channel, giving a seamless, frameless look pulled tight as a drum.

Single or double sided — which do I need? Single-sided for a backwall against a wall or curtain; double-sided when both faces are visible, like a freestanding divider.

Does the fabric wrinkle in transit? The tension fabric is wrinkle-resistant and pulls flat under frame tension; light creases relax within minutes of setup.

How fast can I get one? Five business days from approved proof to shipped.

20ft SEG tension-fabric backwalls, printed in LA and shipped 5 business days after proof approval. Call (844) 883-3308 for sizing help.

b16.descriptionHtml:
A 10x10 is the workhorse of the trade show floor — the entry-level footprint that still gives you a full 30 feet of branded canopy across the top. Ours is custom-printed end to end, built to order, and delivered in 5 business days from proof approval. The clock starts the day you approve your proof.

The canopy is dye-sublimated in full color on weatherproof tent fabric, so the print bonds into the material instead of sitting on top of it. It won't crack, peel, or wash out the way surface vinyl does. The frame is heavy-duty powder-coated aluminum — pop-up, no tools, and it packs into a wheeled bag you can roll through a hotel lobby.

What you can build

  • Tent Only — custom canopy + frame
  • Half Wall — canopy + one half back wall for sightline control
  • Full Wall — canopy + full back wall for a photo-ready backdrop
  • Complete Set — canopy, full wall, and side rails: the whole booth in one box

The details that matter

  • Full-color dye-sublimation print, edge to edge — no blank panels
  • Heavy-duty powder-coated aluminum frame
  • Pop-up setup, no tools required
  • Wheeled carry bag included
  • Free digital proof before we print — nothing goes to production without your sign-off
  • Printed to order in Los Angeles, backed by 20+ years of dye-sub production

Common questions

How fast can I get a custom 10x10 tent? Five business days from approved proof to shipped, nationwide.

Will the print fade outdoors? No. Dye-sublimation bonds the ink into the fabric, so it holds color through sun and weather far longer than a surface vinyl print.

Do I see it before it prints? Yes — we send a free digital proof and don't produce anything until you approve it.

Can you match my exact brand colors? Yes. Send your logo and color values; our production team matches them before anything goes to print.

Custom 10x10 event tents, printed in LA and shipped 5 business days after proof approval. Questions on sizing or artwork? Call (844) 883-3308 or start your order above.

b17.descriptionHtml:
Custom printed pillowcase backdrop with tension fabric display frame — delivered in 5 business days from proof approval.

Premium dye-sublimated fabric print that slips over the frame like a pillowcase for a seamless, wrinkle-free finish. Available in 3ft and 4ft widths, single or double-sided print.

Lightweight, portable, and sets up in under 5 minutes. Perfect for step-and-repeat backdrops, photo ops, product launches, and booth branding. Double-sided print upgrade is free.

Every order proofed before production. 4.8★ rated. Printed in LA.

b18.descriptionHtml:
Professional trade show presence in one compact bundle — save 15%. Delivered in 5 business days from proof approval.

What's included:

  • Straight Tension Fabric Display (your choice of 8ft or 10ft, single or double sided)
  • Pillowcase Backdrop (fabric tension display, matched to your display size)

Both pieces feature vibrant dye-sublimated fabric printing on lightweight, portable aluminum frames. Set up in under 10 minutes with zero tools required.

Perfect for: trade shows, conferences, indoor expos, corporate events, and showroom displays.

Design not included. We proof every order before production. Need help with artwork? Visit our design resources page for free templates and guides.

Need a custom configuration? Call us at (844) 883-3308.

b19.descriptionHtml:
Level up your event presence — custom tent, flag, and table throw in one bundle. Save 15%. Delivered in 5 business days from proof approval.

What's included:

  • Your choice of Event Tent (10x10, 10x15, or 10x20)
  • Your choice of Flag (teardrop, rectangle, feather convex, feather angled, or econo)
  • Your choice of Table Throw (stretch cover, draped throw, or table runner)

Full-color dye sublimation printing on all pieces. Heavy-duty aluminum tent frame rated for outdoor use. Flag includes pole and ground stake base.

Perfect for: trade shows, expos, conferences, outdoor activations, and recurring events.

Design not included. We proof every order before production. Need help with artwork? Visit our design resources page for free templates and guides.

Need a custom configuration? Call us at (844) 883-3308.

b20.descriptionHtml:
Everything you need for your first event — one order, one delivery, 15% off. Delivered in 5 business days from proof approval.

What's included:

  • 10ft x 10ft Custom Printed Event Tent (frame + canopy)
  • Custom Tent Banner
  • Your choice of Table Throw (stretch cover, draped throw, or table runner)

Full-color dye sublimation printing on all pieces. Heavy-duty aluminum tent frame rated for outdoor use. Wheeled carry bag and stake kit included with tent.

Perfect for: farmers markets, pop-up shops, outdoor vendors, and community events.

Design not included. We proof every order before production. Need help with artwork? Visit our design resources page for free templates and guides.

Need a custom configuration? Call us at (844) 883-3308.
